questions.explanation: In reported questions, the tense shifts back: 'do you live' → 'I lived'.
questions.q: 'Where do you live?' she asked. → She asked me where I ___.

questions.explanation: Yes/no questions use 'if'/'whether' and the tense shifts back.
questions.q: 'Are you coming?' he asked. → He asked if I ___.

questions.explanation: Past simple in a direct question becomes past perfect in reported speech.
questions.q: 'Did you see the film?' she asked. → She asked if I ___ the film.

questions.explanation: Orders are reported with 'told + object + to-infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Open the window,' he said. → He ___ me to open the window.

questions.explanation: Negative orders: 'told + object + not to + infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Don't be late!' she said. → She told me ___ late.

questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order: 'it was', not 'was it'.
questions.q: 'What time is it?' he asked. → He asked what time ___.

questions.explanation: Reported questions use statement word order and a backshifted tense.
options: She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where do I live.
She asked me where I lived.
She asked where did I live.
questions.q: Which sentence is correct?

questions.explanation: Yes/no questions: 'if' + statement order + backshifted modal.
questions.q: 'Can you help me?' she asked. → She asked ___ help her.

questions.explanation: Orders: 'told + object + to-infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Sit down,' the teacher said. → The teacher told us ___ down.

questions.explanation: Present perfect in a direct question becomes past perfect.
questions.q: 'Have you finished?' he asked. → He asked if I ___.

questions.explanation: Negative orders: 'told + object + not to + infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Don't touch that!' she said. → She told him ___ that.

questions.explanation: Reported wh-questions: statement order + backshifted tense.
questions.q: 'Why are you crying?' he asked. → He asked why I ___.

questions.explanation: 'Will' becomes 'would' in reported questions.
questions.q: 'Will you marry me?' he asked. → He asked if I ___ marry him.

questions.explanation: Requests: 'asked + object + to-infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Please be quiet,' she said. → She asked us ___ quiet.

questions.explanation: Reported questions don't invert: 'if I was', not 'was I'.
options: He asked me if I was tired.
He asked me was I tired.
He asked me whether I was tired.
He asked if I was tired.
questions.q: Which sentence is WRONG?

questions.explanation: Present perfect becomes past perfect in reported questions.
questions.q: 'Where have you been?' she asked. → She asked where I ___.

questions.explanation: Orders: 'told + object + to-infinitive'.
questions.q: 'Turn off your phones,' he said. → He told us ___ our phones.

questions.explanation: Yes/no questions use 'if' + backshifted tense: 'liked'.
questions.q: 'Do you like tea?' she asked. → She asked ___ tea.

questions.explanation: Requests: 'asked me to open' — no 'to' after 'asked me', no 'said me'.
options: He asked to me to open the door.
He asked me open the door.
He asked me to open the door.
He said me to open the door.
questions.q: Which of the following sentences is correct?

questions.explanation: Present perfect becomes past perfect in reported questions.
questions.q: 'How long have you waited?' he asked. → He asked how long I ___.
